analyze_slurm_meta_exp: analyze a Slurm meta-experiment directory and return a DataFrame with job states, elapsed times, and failure logs
collect_all_meta_experiments_in_one_df: collect all meta-experiments into a single DataFrame by processing journal logs, gathering data, and joining Slurm info
format_experiment_data: format an experiments DataFrame into competition reports with scores, medals, percentiles, and rank for each method and seed
filter_dataframe_based_on_data_validity: filter a DataFrame to ensure every competition-method-seed group has at least one valid node and overwrite invalid groups with sentinel scores
parse_into_aggregate_dict: parse a report DataFrame into a dictionary of per-method numpy matrices pivoted by competition and seed for a given metric
